qa.question: How do I process a customer refund?
qa.text: Open Orders, find the order, and refund only Delivered orders after Check stock shows the item is back in stock [S1]. Choose a refund reason and click Issue refund, typing the order number again [S1]. The Customer refund process (simulated back office) says refunds above $200 need a supervisor code, while How to process a customer refund (screen recording, simulated back office) says refunds above $500 need a supervisor code [S1][S5]. Click Confirm refund and wait for the green confirmation message, as a refund cannot be reversed once confirmed [S1][S2].

qa.question: Why do we check stock before paying a refund?
qa.text: We check stock because the returned item must be back in stock before any refund is paid [S1]. The item has to be back on the shelf before we pay anything out [S2].

qa.question: Above what amount does a refund need a supervisor code?
qa.text: The Customer refund process (simulated back office) says refunds above $200 need a supervisor code [S1]. The How to process a customer refund (screen recording, simulated back office) says any refund above $500 needs a supervisor code [S2].

qa.question: What was Viet Nam's GDP growth in 2023?
qa.text: The ASEAN Economic Indicators Report reports Viet Nam's 2023 real GDP growth as 5.0 percent [S1]. The Regional expansion review deck reports Viet Nam grew 6.5% in 2023 [S4]. The ASEAN Economic Indicators Report says the Philippines grew fastest in 2023 at 5.5 percent [S2]. The Regional expansion review deck says Viet Nam was the fastest economy in ASEAN in 2023 [S4].

qa.question: Which country grew fastest in 2024?
qa.text: In 2024 Viet Nam led the region with real GDP growth of 7.0 percent [S2].

qa.question: How did Myanmar's economy do in 2024?
qa.text: In 2024 Myanmar's economy contracted by 1.0 percent [S1].

qa.question: How much can I spend per month without asking?
qa.text: You get a single User Limit of $5,000 per month in Brex for individual subscriptions, coworking, equipment, training, etc. [S3] The $5,000 is a ceiling, not a target, so only spend what you can justify as in PostHog's best interest. [S3]

qa.question: How many days off am I expected to take each year?
qa.text: PostHog offers unlimited time off, but expects you to take at least 25 days off a year, including national holidays [S1]. The 25 days is a minimum, not a guide [S1].

qa.question: How long is the notice period if I resign?
qa.text: We ask for 30 days of notice by default, unless a different local maximum or minimum applies, and expect you to work during that notice period [S2].

qa.question: How much can I spend on books each month without asking?
qa.text: You can spend up to $50/month on books without asking for permission [S1].

qa.question: Who owns a side project that I built using company code?
qa.text: A side project born from work inside PostHog, including using PostHog code, belongs to PostHog and should live in PostHog repos [S2]. If you want to develop it further on the side, you will need explicit permission [S2].

qa.question: How much time do company meetings take per week at most?
qa.text: Company meetings are kept minimal at no more than 2hrs total per week [S1].
